title: On Casting a long shadow across the yard
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：cast　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cast 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the grower ① cast a long shadow across the yard at once, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② casts a long shadow across the yard in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cast a long shadow across the yard at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cast a long shadow across the yard before — a line in the ledger for August 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Casting a long shadow across the yard at once, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cast the bell in the old mould in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cast the bell in the old mould at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ casts the bell in the old mould at once every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cast a long shadow across the yard again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cast a long shadow across the yard, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody casts a long shadow across the yard in the rain again and somebody must cast a long shadow across the yard at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 投下（一般过去式 cast a long shadow across the yard：1989 年种植户头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 投下（一般现在 casts a long shadow across the yard：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 投下（不定式 to cast a long shadow across the yard：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 投下（过去完成时 had cast a long shadow across the yard：1983 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 投下（动名词 casting a long shadow across the yard 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 铸造（cast the bell in the old mould：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去铸造用旧模子铸那口钟）
G. v. 铸造（cast the bell in the old mould：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 投下（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 casts the bell in the old mould，而母亲又一次 cast a long shadow across the yard）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cast 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the grower cast a long shadow across the yard at once, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower casts a long shadow across the yard in the rain whenever the greenhouse asks.
Casting a long shadow across the yard at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cast the bell in the old mould in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse casts the bell in the old mould at once every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cast a long shadow across the yard again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
